German Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Germany comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

German documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe Buergeramt190–680 EUR
Driving Licencethe local Fahrerlaubnisbehoerde140–520 EUR
ID Cardthe Buergeramt90–320 EUR
Green Cardthe Auslaenderbehoerde340–1100 EUR
Visaa German mission abroad160–560 EUR
Residence Permitthe Auslaenderbehoerde320–950 EUR

Two checks specific to Germany

  • Check the EU format and confirm the categories in field nine are typeset in the correct row and font.
  • Read the chip with the official AusweisApp, which reads German identity documents.

Local red flag

  • A Personalausweis where field nine categories are crammed rather than typeset.
